NONE: › something such as a structure or experience that, when considered as a whole, has qualities that are more than the total of all its parts
格式塔；完形（一種結構或者經歷，其整體不等於各部分簡單相加之和）
› considering or treating what a person experiences and believes as a whole and separate thing
格式塔心理學的（將個人經歷和信仰作為整體和局部來考慮和治療）

example: This new biography is the first to consider fully the writer's gestalt.
這部新傳記第一次全面地探討了這位作家的各個方面。
In gestalt psychology and gestalt psychotherapy, people's thoughts and emotions are seen as complex wholes.
在格式塔心理學和格式塔精神療法中，人的思想和情感被視為複雜的整體。

U: › specialized biology (the period of) the development of a child or young animal while it is still inside its mother's body
› (the period of) the development of ideas, thoughts, or plans
（想法、思想或計劃的）醞釀（期），孕育（期）

example: The baby was born prematurely at 28 weeks gestation.
胎兒在懷孕的第28周早產。
The period of gestation of rats is 21 days.
老鼠的妊娠期是21天。
The project had a very long gestation period.
這個方案經過了很長時間的醞釀。

NONE: › to make movements with your hands or arms, to express something or to emphasize what you are saying
（說話時）做手勢，用手勢表達，用動作（或姿態）示意

example: There was a man outside the window gesticulating wildly.
有個人在窗外拼命做手勢。

C: C1 a movement of the hands, arms, or head, etc. to express an idea or feeling
C1 an action that expresses your feelings or intentions, although it might have little practical effect

NONE: C2 to use a gesture to express or emphasize something
做手勢；用手勢表示；用動作示意

example: The prisoner raised his fist in a gesture of defiance as he was led out of the courtroom.
犯人被帶出法庭時，舉起拳頭以示抗議。
She made a rude gesture at the other driver.
她對另一個司機做了個粗魯的手勢。
The government donated £500,000 as a gesture of goodwill.
該政府捐助了50萬英鎊以示友善。
Eating boiled potatoes instead of chips was his only gesture towards healthy eating.
他說要注意飲食健康，可也僅僅是用煮馬鈴薯代替炸薯條而已。
When he asked where the children were, she gestured vaguely in the direction of the beach.
他問她孩子們在哪裡，她心不在焉地朝沙灘方向指了一下。
He made no answer but walked on, gesturing for me to follow.
他沒有回答而繼續向前走，打了個手勢讓我跟上。

NONE: › any action by a person or organization done for political reasons and intended to attract public attention but having little real effect
政治作秀，姿態政治（個人或組織出於政治目的而做出的動作，意在吸引公眾注意，沒有真正實際效果）

example: The call for a one-day national strike was dismissed as gesture politics.
舉行一天全國性罷工的呼籲被斥為政治作秀。

NONE: › said to someone after they sneezes
（對打噴嚏的人說的吉祥話）百歲，長命百歲，祝你健康

example: See also
bless you!
